# Vendored third-party code

`lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js` is the standalone browser
build of [lightweight-charts](https://github.com/tradingview/lightweight-charts)
v5.2.1 by TradingView, Inc., vendored here so the app has no runtime
dependency on an external CDN. Licensed under Apache License 2.0 -- see
`LIGHTWEIGHT-CHARTS-LICENSE.txt` in this directory. Unmodified from the
upstream npm package's `dist/` output.
